export class Runner {
 async run(items, step) {
  await inOrder(items, step, {reason: ORDER_REASON});
  await inOrderSteps([step], {reason: ORDER_REASON});
 }
 async short(items, step) {
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrder(items, step, {reason: SHORT_REASON});
 }
 async shadow(items, step, ORDER_REASON) {
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrder(items, step, {reason: ORDER_REASON});
 }
}
const ORDER_REASON = 'Each update reads the previous write';
const SHORT_REASON = 'too short';
